title: Special Problems in Physics; Workforce Skills Development for Physics Undergraduates
description: Prerequisites: PHYS171 or permission of instructor Supports students navigating opportunities in the workforce. Building self-confidence through skills assessments, identifying potential career paths, and learning effective job search strategies. Students will connect with professionals across industry to grow their network, build resumes, and conduct mock interviews. Includes mentoring and developing awareness of workforce diversity issues. Restriction: Intended for Physics Majors
